prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Empire C02 science-fiction skill icon. One isolated genuine transparent RGBA cutout on a square 1254×1254 canvas, designed to read at actual 48×48 with center anchor [24,24].
Input roles: Image 1 is the exact visually verified original high-resolution skill-board subject card and determines functional subject, broad colors and action direction. Its magenta exterior is contamination/background and MUST NOT be copied. Image 2 is accepted C02 cargo-crate STYLE ONLY: imitate chunky simplified masses, confident heavy contour, broad matte planes and restrained cel-shaded values; do not copy crates or cargo hardware.
Style: Exaggerated chunky hand-drawn cartoon sci-fi shapes with thick stable dark contour and clear opaque material planes. Two or three value steps per material, few essential seams, tiny bounded highlights. Large functional forms replace micro-panels, rivets, scratches and noise. No photorealism, glossy 3D, oil paint, dense edge wear, medieval gear or broad glow.
Composition: Keep the original complete functional motif as one tightly grouped centered icon. Entire icon including action glyphs stays inside 8% empty transparent margins on EVERY side, with no clipped tips. Use the full square canvas. No text, logo, watermark, badge rim, rectangular background tile, decorative floor, cast shadow or unrelated UI panel.
Transparency: true transparent exterior and open gaps. Physical parts and action glyphs are opaque colored shapes. No painted checkerboard, white/magenta/black backdrop, mist, aura, bloom, light bleed or colored fringe. Bounded action glyphs may be bright but must have clean hard edges with no exterior illumination.
Primary request: Rebuild 零权限突入 / zero-permission breach. Preserve one thick freestanding graphite-gray sci-fi access gate in shallow three-quarter view, a tall beveled rectangular metal frame with an orange inner seal and a dark open center. Retain the small rectangular keypad/control module on the RIGHT side containing three simple pale-cyan horizontal bars. The LEFT side of the gate is fractured and bent outward, with a few chunky dark broken pieces close to the frame. Across the opening is ONE large sharp orange/amber impact starburst with pale-yellow center. Its two principal long intersecting rays run diagonally from upper-left to lower-right and from lower-left to upper-right, with several short triangular points clustered tightly at the center. Make the burst broad opaque flat graphic planes with a clean orange dark edge, not lens flare, fire, smoke, sparks or an energy cloud. Keep the door frame visibly recognizable behind the burst and retain the asymmetry of the damaged left side and intact keypad right side. The original motif represents a forced security breach without any person shown. No running person, weapon, padlock, numeric zero, text, logo, additional door, wall tile, ground plane, shadow, explosion smoke or exterior glow.
